selected.summary: The prior governed research found a credible reversible state machine but an unreliable governed-state browser projection. Its ranked work is current-head projection, visible-change diff integrity, preview coherence, durable action framing, deterministic e2e, claim-bounded handoff semantics, mobile and annotation usability, documentation sync, and only then a minimal CraftEvidencePack.
selected.obligation_fit: Makes governed truth versus polished surface a mandatory architecture-review axis and supplies current-head, style-diff, e2e, and handoff selectors for literal verification.

excluded.match: Body War and TROQAR interaction evidence
excluded.reason: It is selector and copy-obligation precedent, not proof of the Studio's current architecture, implementation, or release readiness.

It is a subordinate comparison surface only. The review may test whether Studio documents preserve that boundary, but it must not treat Open Design as Studio authority or expand into an Open Design review.

selectors: status, contexts, decisions, active_blockers, active_gaps, artifacts, next_moves
current_artifact_evidence.summary: The Craft ledger is the scoped state authority, but its root and extraction next-move text is older than later implementation evidence and does not index the July governed-state plan. Root architecture, spec, work-pack, and plan documents overlap and contain proposal-era statements that may no longer describe the live standalone system.

The June deep-spec run is a flagged proposal and historical evidence snapshot. It did not mutate the canonical spec; its own result limits realistic one-shot readiness to L0-L2, while the one-shot plan describes the broader L0-L6 target and older web/mock-api seams.

The July package is the newest coherent proposal and correctly centers governed-state projection, but it remains phase flag. Its sequencing must be checked because SWU-GSP-001 requires Playwright proof while SWU-GSP-004 independently owns repair of the currently failing Corepack-dependent e2e helper.

selectors: preview primary cards and annotation source
current_artifact_evidence.summary: Current source still separates the governed current-head raw route from the primary preview and annotation surfaces, excludes style nodes from structural diff fragments, and starts e2e helpers through pnpm. The current coordinator check observed typecheck and 62 unit/slice tests passing, while all 13 e2e tests failed before browser behavior because the helper route crashed in Corepack/pnpm; reviewers must reproduce or independently verify any surviving claim.

gaps: The Inventory entry records the July 9 research but does not establish the current July 27 runtime state.
No Inventory Evidence Card or EvidenceSet is available for this target.
The Craft ledger does not visibly bind the July 10 governed-state projection work-pack into its indexes or next moves.
Fresh checked-in browser evidence is unavailable until the e2e helper failure is repaired or a repository-owned equivalent witness is admitted.
The relation among root ARCHITECTURE/SPEC/WORK-PACK, the deep-spec proposal, and the July plan has no single explicit authority or supersession map.
residue: Inventory is discovery context and every surviving finding must quote and verify a current target artifact.
A green unit suite does not establish browser projection, accessibility, ergonomics, or release readiness.
An e2e harness failure blocks browser evidence but is not itself proof of a product behavior failure.
The deep-spec proposal may contain still-useful design intent even where its paths, lifecycle assumptions, or readiness language are stale.
This review can recommend an authority hierarchy and change requests, but it cannot promote a proposal, mutate Craft, or implement the plan.
non_authority_notice: This packet is a read-only Inventory projection. It does not authorize the dispatch, establish current runtime truth, promote deep-spec material, approve a plan, or permit target mutation.
design_consequence: All attackers read the complete architecture-plan corpus. Their methodologies are deliberately tensioned across formal contract and governance analysis, computational runtime falsification, and historical supersession tracing. Verifiers separately attack definitions and scope versus reproducible counterexamples. Findings must end with per-artifact KEEP/FIX verdicts, an explicit authority and supersession recommendation, and a dependency-safe next-plan recommendation bounded by reproducible evidence.
